text:
jia: quick heads-up — running long-context KV-cache smoke tests on redwood-open-13B-ctx64k-q4, and I see output drift around ~32k tokens. suspect RoPE wrap / position misalignment.
marco: can you paste the repro command?
jia: yep:
```bash
./tests/kv_smoke.py --model redwood-open-13B-ctx64k-q4 --seed 42 --length 65536 --step 1024 --replay-offset 16384
```
jia: log snippet (trimmed):
```
[INFO] step=32768 prefix_match=0.997
[WARN] step=32769 cache_miss=1.0 token_mismatch expected="the" got="the the"
[DEBUG] kv_replay_offset=16384 ropescale=1.0
```
sara: is this only in q4 quantized builds or also fp16?
jia: reproduced in q4_0 and fp16, but frequency is higher in q4. so quantization amplifies it but not sole cause.
marco: that points to a position encoding / KV indexing bug. rope wrap-around when absolute positions > model_ctx? which model codepath handles rotation?
leo: quick check — did you try toggling RoPE scaling (linear vs dynamic)?
jia: yes. toggling rope_scale to "dynamic" reduces but doesn't eliminate. exact mismatch patterns look like repeated small phrase insertions when cache replay crosses a boundary.
eval-bot: nightly-kvcache: FAILED 1/240 tests. failing-id: kvcache-20250130-42. attached sample prompt: kvcache-20250130-42.txt
marco: can you drop the failing prompt here?
jia: putting a minimized repro (very short):
```text
PROMPT: A: 1 2 3 4 ... (repeated tokens up to 33000)
EXPECTED_NEXT: "end"
MODEL_OUTPUT_AT_32769: "end end"
```
leo: this looks like repeated token emission after a cache replay. i remember a past bug where position ids used for rotary scaling were computed from cumulative tokens instead of per-request base when reusing the cache.
sara: also add a test that replays the same kv cache with different user-supplied "start_pos" to make sure absolute->relative mapping is correct.
marco: agreed. plan: 1) add targeted unit test to kvcache harness that rotates base_pos around multiples of 4096 and 65536; 2) run on fp16 and q4_0 and q8_0; 3) capture raw attention keys/queries for a few heads to diff; 4) if repro, bisect kernel change last 2 months.
jia: created PR branch: fix/kv-rope-repro-1738204567 with test. pushing logs to /tmp/kvruns/1738204567.
ops-bot: provisioning dev-a100 job 68421 for jia (ETA 4m).
leo: i'll run the same harness on dedicated node (A100 multi). will also try model variant redwood-open-34B-ctx64k-fp16 to check scale.
sara: if it's not quant-specific, can we add assertion to detect duplicated token sequences during replay as a safety check? failsafe until root cause fixed.
jia: yes. adding an "assert_no_repeats_on_replay" toggle to harness. if triggered, evallog will save full kv dump and model state.
marco: one more thought — RoPE implementation use of sin/cos precompute might overflow index when using 64k context; ensure the precompute uses modulo correctly. I saw a PR that changed angle dtype rounding earlier.
leo: i'll grep commits for "rope_precompute" since last release.
marco: thanks. if anyone can run bisect of runtimes between commit abc123..def456 i'd appreciate it.
ops-bot: job 68421 started on dev-a100-2 (attached logs: s3://redwood-dev/logs/68421).
jia: next steps for today: 1) unit test + harness in PR 2) run on A100 via job 68421 3) collect head-level Q/K diffs 4) decide rollback vs hotfix based on bisect.
leo: i'll take (2)+(3). jia: you own (1). marco: you run bisect.
sara: noted — ack from me once we have head diffs. :thumbsup:
jia: thanks all, will post a short failing example to the thread once the harness finishes.
marco: ping me if you need quick help parsing the kv dump, I have a small script that visualizes head-wise cos similarities.
eval-bot: Attached failing example uploaded: s3://redwood-dev/tests/kvcache/kvcache-20250130-42-repro.tar.gz
leo: received. starting analysis now.
ops-bot: reminder: please annotate any customer-impacting findings in #incidents if you see regressions in hosted traffic.
sara: good reminder. closing loop — let’s not ship any new quantized 64k builds until we have a green fix.
jia: agreed. will block the pipeline for ctx64k q4 until PR merges.
leo: update in ~2h or when I have diffs.
marco: thanks team.
